introduction: I’m Aaban Rehman, an AI engineer building practical AI integrations and automated workflows, backed by C#, ASP.NET Core, .NET 8 and .NET 9.
about: I’m Aaban Rehman, based in Islamabad, Pakistan. I bring a software engineering background to AI integrations and workflow automation: connecting models, APIs, data, and the business rules around them. My toolkit includes ASP.NET Core, .NET 8 and .NET 9, Azure, and a local Ollama environment. I care about clear boundaries, human review, and explaining the tradeoffs.
projectsIntro:
AI workflow concepts, local AI infrastructure, and business platforms.
Explore each project for its context and engineering approach.
servicesIntro: From connecting a local model to an existing API to designing an automated business workflow, I focus on useful AI with clear boundaries and dependable software behind it.
contactIntro: A new product, an API that needs attention, or a team that could use another engineer. Tell me where you are and where you want to go.
